findings.citation_text: Researchers use various sensors, such as accelerator [4, 32], gyroscope [40], Wi-Fi [57], mmWave [5, 30, 31, 55], and RFID [12, 37, 56] to capture speaker/microphone vibration or nearby surface vibration patterns for eavesdropping on speaker-produced or/and human-speaking sound.
findings.reasoning: This context groups [56] with other RFID works in a list of side-channel sound eavesdropping methods that sense vibration. It does not single out [56] for unique capabilities, nor does it describe sub-mm precision. It is a background listing.
